identity_policy: Two physically prepared simple blends with different lignin mass fractions, 10 and 30 wt.% of total polymer mass. Section 2.3 records separate 50 g formulation extrusion; Table 6 records separate experimental tensile results. Existing B0, B20 and Indulin AT are not repeated. Processing states, DCP-reactive counterparts and repeated tests do not create further identities in this packet.
